label: ‼️ macOS: uncheck to use Zen's own menus, which the style options below need (hiding options works either way). Check this again ✅ before removing this mod
🔁 Reorder the tab context menu: tab actions first, then moving and organizing, then closing (enabled by default)
⚡ Quick actions: Reload, Pin, Essentials and Bookmark as a row of buttons at the top of the tab context menu
🔗 Prioritize 'Copy Clean Link' when possible (enabled by default)
✂️ Hide unavailable options (the ones shown greyed out, like Paste with nothing copied)
🔣 Restore icons for context menu options (turns off hiding icons)
🔣 Hide icons in context menus (extensions, containers...), except checkboxes and radio buttons (turns off restoring icons)
🎨 Icon style for restored icons and the quick actions: Zen's, or Fluent or ZenUI from Context Menu Icons by Starry-AXQG
🩶 Gray extension icons in context menus (in color again under the pointer)
〰️ Hide all separators (turns off faint separators)
〰️ Faint separators: draw the lines between groups of options at half strength (turns off hiding them)
🎨 Apply your space's gradient to menus and panels (turns off its accent color)
🎨 Apply your space's accent color (the main color of its gradient) to menus and panels (turns off its gradient)
